ZeratulMasteryGreaterCleaveCleave.name: Greater Cleave
ZeratulMasteryGreaterCleaveCleave.description: Increases the radius of Cleave by 33%.

ZeratulShadowHunter.name: Shadow Hunter
ZeratulShadowHunter.description: Quest: Gather Regeneration Globes to lower the Mana cost of Blink by 3, up to 45. Reward: Upon gathering 15 Regeneration Globes, Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Blink by 1.5 seconds.

ZeratulMoveUnseen.name: Move Unseen
ZeratulMoveUnseen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Permanent Cloak by 1 second. Gain 30% Movement Speed while Stealthed.

ZeratulRendingCleave.name: Rending Cleave
ZeratulRendingCleave.description: Cleave deals an additional 40% damage over 3 seconds.

ZeratulPsionicStrength.name: Psionic Strength
ZeratulPsionicStrength.description: Dealing damage to enemy Heroes increases all damage dealt by 6% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 30%.

ZeratulDarknessDescends.name: Darkness Descends
ZeratulDarknessDescends.description: Activate to gain 40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Passive: Gain 20% Attack Speed.

ZeratulWormhole.name: Wormhole
ZeratulWormhole.description: After 1.25 seconds, reactivate Blink to return to the point where it was cast from within 4 seconds.

ZeratulSeekerInTheDark.name: Seeker in the Dark
ZeratulSeekerInTheDark.description: Singularity Spike takes 50% longer to explode. It can be reactivated to teleport to the target, granting 30% increased Move Speed for 3 seconds.

ZeratulWarpSkirmisherTalent.name: Warp Skirmisher
ZeratulWarpSkirmisherTalent.description: Vorpal Blade gains a 2nd charge. Teleporting to an enemy with Vorpal Blade or entering Permanent Cloak causes Zeratul's next Basic Attack to deal 50% more damage.

ZeratulMightOfTheNerazim.name: Might Of The Nerazim
ZeratulMightOfTheNerazim.description: Activate to cast an untalented version of Zeratul's most recently used Basic Ability, dealing 50% less damage. Passive: After using an Ability, Zeratul's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 30% more damage.

ZeratulHeroicAbilityVoidPrison.name: Void Prison
ZeratulHeroicAbilityVoidPrison.description: Slows time in an area to a near standstill, placing allies and enemies in Time Stop for 5 seconds. Zeratul is not affected.

ZeratulShroudofAdun.name: Shroud of Adun
ZeratulShroudofAdun.description: Zeratul gains a Shield equal to 20% of his Maximum Health over 3 seconds while under Permanent Cloak.

ZeratulMendingStrikes.name: Mending Strikes
ZeratulMendingStrikes.description: Basic Attacks heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

GenericTalentSpellShield.name: Spell Shield
GenericTalentSpellShield.description: Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

ZeratulMasterWarpBlade.name: Master Warp-Blade
ZeratulMasterWarpBlade.description: Every third consecutive Basic Attack against the same target deals 125% more damage.

ZeratulVoidSlash.name: Void Slash
ZeratulVoidSlash.description: If Cleave hits more than one enemy Hero, it deals 40% increased damage and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

ZeratulSentencedtoDeath.name: Sentenced to Death
ZeratulSentencedtoDeath.description: Deal 25% increased damage to enemies while they are marked or Slowed by Singularity Spike.

ZeratulTwilightFalls.name: Twilight Falls
ZeratulTwilightFalls.description: Might of the Nerazim resets the cooldown of all Basic Abilities.

ZeratulUnwaveringPressure.name: Unwavering Pressure
ZeratulUnwaveringPressure.description: Singularity Spike no longer costs Mana. Basic Attacks against enemies reduce its cooldown by 1.25 seconds, double versus Heroes.

ZeratulShadowStrideTalent.name: Shadow Stride
ZeratulShadowStrideTalent.description: Reduce the cooldown of Vorpal Blade by 10 seconds. Casting Vorpal Blade grants Zeratul a Shield that absorbs up to 260 damage for 3 seconds.

ZeratulShadowMending.name: Shadow Mending
ZeratulShadowMending.description: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.
